== Summary ==
Kevin Reitzel points out the porta potties on the cold and rainy beach - inside plumbing reserved for Decipher staff. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Kevin Reitzel]].
